description:
Goal: delete metadata that claims to enforce a compiler-shape contract but has no consumer. There are 500 budget.* lines in 50 behavioral fixtures. FixtureMetadata parses them into BudgetAssertion, but no harness compares them with telemetry; the old fz dump --emit stats counters and tolerance workflow were deleted with the old compiler. The current matrix discovers every fixtures2/behavior/*.fz by default, so these keys do not own fixture participation.

Do not revive old planner/codegen numbers or translate them into new metrics without a newly demonstrated current invariant. Delete all budget.* fixture lines, BudgetAssertion/budget_assertions and the generic parser arm, their tests/public exports, and the stale GOLDEN.md/.agent fixture documentation. Audit and remove the participation predicates too if they remain caller-free; do not retain a dead API solely because budget parsing once fed it. Make budget.* an unknown metadata key so stale decoration cannot silently return.

Acceptance: rg finds no budget.* frontmatter or deleted dump-budget workflow; the shared metadata model has no BudgetAssertion; every affected behavioral fixture is still discovered and its real behavior contract still runs; metadata, fixture-matrix discovery, lib, and clippy tests pass. Current compiler-shape signals continue to use assert.metric.* and telemetry-derived facts.
title: Delete decorative old-compiler budget metadata and its dead model
